marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 15 knots increasing to northwest 25 near midnight
and to northwest 35 late overnight. Wind diminishing to northwest 25 near noon
Sunday and to northwest 15 early Sunday evening. Periods of rain tonight and Sunday. Fog
patches. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 after midnight then
subsiding to 1 near noon Sunday.<br/>
